scope: Corollary 4.3 (A supporting class for the induction) of the manuscript “Anticanonical nonvanishing from smooth semipositivity” (preprints/Anticanonical-nonvanishing-from-smooth-semipositivity-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ff5a08aaa3d9ad23), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 14-15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Under the hypotheses of Theorem 4.2, assume dim Z > 0 and let L be a pseudoeffective line bundle for which L + D is not big. There exists a nonzero real movable class α with L · α = D · α = 0. For this class µmin,α(TZ) ≥ 0. Suppose moreover that M → (Ω1 Z)⊗k is nonzero and that effective divisors Ni ∼ M + miL are given. Then M · α = Ni · α = 0 for every i. 14 Every finite nonnegative linear combination of D, N1, N2, . . . has zero intersection with α and is not big.
